text: I'll start by looking at the workspace layout and finding the pagination code.
The bug is visible at line 31: `end = start + page_size - 1` is used as the slice end, which is inclusive-style, but Python slices are exclusive. Let me read the file to confirm how `end` is used.

Confirmed: `items[start:end]` with `end = start + page_size - 1` drops the last item of every full page (for page size 5, items at index 4, 9, ... are never returned), which matches the "regular interval" gap described. The fix is to make the slice end `start + page_size`.

args.summary: Fixed an off-by-one in library/pagination.py's paginate(): the slice end was computed as `start + page_size - 1`, but Python slice ends are exclusive, so the last item of every full page was dropped (e.g. with page size 5, items at positions 5, 10, ... never appeared). This explains the repeating gap in the reported catalog. Changed the end to `start + page_size`. The full test suite passes (29 tests).
